2024_general.fact: No Clarity link on the results page. Only 2024 general files are re-uploaded 'accessible' copies (wp-content/uploads/2026/04). The unofficial 'Cumulative-Results-11-6-2024-10-15-52-AM-accessible.pdf' is county totals, 'Run Time 10:15 AM ... Run Date 11/06/2024', CreationDate Nov 6 2024 16:16 UTC: after election night. No 2024 precinct report listed. No election-night file survives; check 3 unavailable (no Brazos folder on wayback-data).

2026_primary.fact: 'March 3, 2026 Primary Election - Cumulative Results (Unofficial)' (Cumulative-Results-3-3-2026-accessible.pdf): county totals with Absentee/Early/Election Day columns, 'Run Time 9:28 PM ... Run Date 03/03/2026', CreationDate Mar 4 2026 03:32 UTC (9:32 PM CST); server Last-Modified Apr 6 2026 (re-upload). Precinct reports (e.g. Arena-Hall-ED-Precinct-Report-3-3-26-accessible.pdf) are 'Official Results', 'Run Date 04/10/2026', Last-Modified Apr 15 2026. Election-night county totals by printed run time; precinct numbers only after the canvass.

2026_runoff.fact: 'May 26, 2026 Primary Runoff Election - Cumulative Results (Unofficial)' (uploads/2026/05/Unofficial-Cumulative-Results-05262026.pdf): county totals, 'Run Time 9:09 PM ... Run Date 05/26/2026', CreationDate May 27 02:11 UTC, Last-Modified Wed 27 May 2026 03:15:57 GMT (10:15 PM CDT). No runoff precinct candidate report listed; only official cumulative, reconciliation (turnout by location) and hand count audit files dated June 2026. Precinct candidate numbers not published online.

rationale: Primary and runoff both LATER from county-posted reports (election-night county totals, no precinct candidate numbers that night); 2024 has no surviving election-night file. Two LATER give COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS.

comparison_notes.2024_general: same (UNDETERMINED): only the 11/06/2024 10:15 AM unofficial totals and official files survive, all re-uploaded April 2026.
comparison_notes.2026_primary: different: research UNDETERMINED, I said LATER (check 2). Both see the unofficial county totals printed 9:28 PM 3/3/2026 (CreationDate 03:32 UTC Mar 4). Research held that the per-location precinct reports might have been posted on election night before the April 2026 re-upload; I opened Arena-Hall-ED-Precinct-Report-3-3-26-accessible.pdf and it reads 'Official Results', 'Run Date 04/10/2026', so the surviving precinct reports are post-canvass. Difference in reading the rule, not in facts; does not change the tag.
comparison_notes.2026_runoff: same (LATER, check 2): run 9:09 PM, Last-Modified 03:15:57 GMT May 27 (10:15 PM CDT), no runoff precinct candidate report.
